privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Deglem collects, uses, stores, and shares information when you use the app.
privacy.s1.title: Information we collect
privacy.s1.body:
We collect the account information you provide, such as your email address and profile details including name, height, weight, goals, language, and notification preferences.

When you log meals, we collect meal photos and store meal details such as nutrition estimates, ingredients, timestamps, notes, and progress information. Meal photos may be sent for analysis as described below.

We never collect your weight progress photos. Weight progress photos stay only on your device and are not uploaded or synced to your account.
privacy.s2.title: Meal photo analysis
privacy.s2.body:
When you ask Deglem to analyze a meal photo, the image is compressed and sent through our backend to an AI provider so nutrition estimates can be generated. The provider may process the image and prompt only to return the requested analysis.

AI-generated nutrition information is an estimate and can be inaccurate. You should review and adjust results when needed.
privacy.s3.title: How we use information
privacy.s3.body:
We use your information to provide the app, sync your account, calculate goals, estimate nutrition, track progress, process subscriptions, prevent abuse, troubleshoot issues, and improve reliability.

We may use aggregated or de-identified information to understand app usage and improve features.
privacy.s4.title: Sharing
privacy.s4.body:
We do not sell your personal information. We share information with service providers that help us operate Deglem, including authentication, backend hosting, AI analysis, payment processing, and notification services.

We may disclose information if required by law, to protect users, or to protect the security and integrity of Deglem.
privacy.s5.title: Data storage and security
privacy.s5.body:
We use reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your information. No system is completely secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security.

Some app data may be stored locally on your device. If you delete the app or clear local data, locally stored weight progress photos and unsynced data may be lost.
privacy.s6.title: Your choices
privacy.s6.body:
You can update profile details in the app and control meal reminder settings from your profile. You can also choose not to provide photos or context for meal analysis.

To request account or data deletion, contact us using the support channel provided for Deglem.
privacy.s7.title: Changes
privacy.s7.body: We may update this Privacy Policy as Deglem changes. If we make material changes, we will update the date above and provide notice where appropriate.
terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.intro: These Terms and Conditions govern your use of Deglem. By using the app, you agree to these Terms.
terms.s1.title: Using Deglem
terms.s1.body:
Deglem helps you track meals, estimate nutrition, set goals, and monitor progress. You are responsible for the information you enter and for keeping your account credentials secure.

You must use Deglem only for lawful purposes and must not misuse, disrupt, reverse engineer, or attempt unauthorized access to the app or its services.
terms.s2.title: Health and nutrition disclaimer
terms.s2.body:
Deglem is not medical advice and is not a substitute for professional healthcare, nutrition, diagnosis, or treatment. Always consult a qualified professional before making significant health, diet, or exercise changes.

Nutrition estimates, calorie goals, BMI information, and AI analysis may be incomplete or inaccurate. You should use your own judgment and verify important information.
terms.s3.title: Accounts
terms.s3.body:
You may need an account to use certain features. You agree to provide accurate information and to keep it up to date.

We may suspend or terminate access if we believe your account is being used in a way that violates these Terms or may harm Deglem, other users, or third-party services.
terms.s4.title: Subscriptions and payments
terms.s4.body:
Paid access may be offered through one-time payment plans. Unless stated otherwise in the app, subscriptions do not auto-renew.

Access periods, prices, and available plans may change. Payment availability and completion may depend on third-party payment providers.
terms.s5.title: User content
terms.s5.body:
You keep ownership of the information and photos you provide. You grant Deglem permission to process that content as needed to provide app features, including meal analysis and account sync.

Do not upload content that you do not have the right to use or that is illegal, harmful, or violates another person's rights.
terms.s6.title: Service availability
terms.s6.body: We aim to keep Deglem reliable, but the app may be unavailable, delayed, or changed from time to time. We may add, modify, or remove features as the product evolves.
terms.s7.title: Limitation of liability
terms.s7.body: To the maximum extent permitted by law, Deglem is provided as is and as available. We are not liable for indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages, or for decisions you make based on app outputs.
terms.s8.title: Changes
terms.s8.body: We may update these Terms as Deglem changes. If you continue using the app after changes take effect, you accept the updated Terms.
